summary: Iteration 2 testing of NikoVision Reviews feature, Services dropdown, content & spec updates. 13/13 backend pytest tests PASS (incl. 6 new Reviews tests). All 32 frontend UI assertions PASS — dropdown, sub-anchor scroll, supply-fitment copy (no casement/double-hung/bifold), uPVC Legend 80 specs (6-chamber/80mm/24–52mm/10yr), Reviews form validation, star rating, successful submission with success toast and new card, and mobile services submenu.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: rating field uses ge=1/le=5 (good), but published default is True with no admin moderation endpoint — any submitter can publish; consider moderation flag/admin route before going live (spam risk).
server.py: no rate-limiting/captcha on POST /api/reviews — same concern as /api/quotes, /api/contact (already flagged in iter1). Public endpoint open to spam.
server.py: CORS still allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True (carried from iter1) — invalid per CORS spec.
Reviews.jsx: text length is validated client-side at >=4 (matches server min_length=4), but no max length on client (server enforces 2000). Low impact.

Layout.jsx: SERVICES_SUB is duplicated implicitly between desktop and mobile via single source — good. nav-link testid for 'uPVC Legend 80' is 'nav-link-upvclegend' (label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g,'')); test request mentioned 'nav-link-upvclegend80' but digits are stripped by regex — request copy was slightly off; actual testid 'nav-link-upvclegend' was verified.
seed_data_creation: Backend test reviews/quotes/contacts prefixed with TEST_ created via API & UI (small footprint, left in DB for inspection).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend now exposes POST/GET /api/reviews (Review model: id/name/suburb/rating[1-5]/text[>=4]/published=true/created_at). GET /api/reviews returns only published, sorted by created_at desc. Frontend nav has Services hover dropdown (data-testid=nav-dropdown-services) with subs nav-sub-{anchor} mapping to /services#{anchor}. Mobile uses mobile-services-toggle + mobile-nav-sub-{anchor}. Reviews component on Home (data-testid=section-reviews) with form toggle reviews-toggle-form, rating-star-1..5 (only when interactive=true inside form), review-name/suburb/text/submit, cards review-card-{id}. nav-link-upvclegend (digits stripped from 'uPVC Legend 80').
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
